title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ukraine, adapted with a German twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then remove from pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot, cover, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Add the Ukrainian sausage to the pot and simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
